job.text: Show which stores fall short of the rating customers count as satisfied, and where

insight.important: Wells and Ripon fell short of a satisfied 7 in every department; checkout was the weakest almost everywhere

title.text: Wells and Ripon Fall Short of a Satisfied 7 Everywhere
title.descriptive: Customer satisfaction (on 10) by store and department, 2022 (synthetic data)

reasons.chart.value_labels: where each store stands against 7 is the message, read from the colours against their key; the scores themselves are not

source.shows: a diverging ramp whose dividing value is the audience's, 7 on a 10-point rating, not the middle of the scale (R3-13, G4.11): two ramps meeting at a light grey at 7, intensity growing with the distance from it, symmetric about 7 and cut at the scale's maximum, so that the key's tick at 7 stands right of its middle (R3-14, R4-9); the values left out so that the key is read (a guided departure, with its reason); red below 7 and green above (D-18); synthetic ratings (the book shows only keys)
